title: What If Humans Could See With Sound? Some Already Do

scenes.text: What if you could see with sound? Some blind people already do it with mouth clicks.
They make sharp clicks and listen to the echoes bouncing back off the world.
In a 2011 study, expert echolocators picked out objects like a tree or a pole from recorded echoes.
Scientists scanned their brains. A visual area lit up when the echoes played.
Sighted volunteers hearing the same recordings showed no such response.
The brain rewired itself, handling sound in the part built for sight.
